text: Licence plates in Brazil were **white **until 2018. Now, a **white plate with a blue stripe** on top is used. Red is still used for commercial vehicles.
text_zh: 巴西的車牌在 2018 年前為**白色**。現在則使用頂部帶有**藍色條紋的白底車牌**。紅色車牌仍用於商業車輛。

text: **Portuguese **is spoken in Brazil, as opposed to most Latin American countries which speak Spanish. Compared to Spanish, some essential differences are that Portuguese uses -ão rather than -ón, -ch/-lh instead of -ll and -nh instead of -ñ.
text_zh: 巴西使用**葡萄牙語**，與大多數講西班牙語的拉丁美洲國家不同。與西班牙語相比，一些主要差異是葡萄牙語使用 -ão 而非 -ón、-ch/-lh 代替 -ll，以及 -nh 代替 -ñ。

text: Soil in most of Brazil is distinctly **red**. It can range from a [light pink](https://goo.gl/maps/n8fe3fywheFqKCTPA) around Mato Grosso to a deep maroon near the Paraná river. The soil is usually not red in the North East, or in the majority of Rio Grande do Sul, however.
NOTE: Parts of Paraguay and the nearby Argentine province of Misiones have deep red soil, as well a handful of other regions around the world.
text_zh: 巴西大部分地區的土壤呈明顯的**紅色**。它的範圍可以從馬托格羅索州附近的[淺粉紅色](https://goo.gl/maps/n8fe3fywheFqKCTPA)到巴拉那河附近的深栗紅色。然而，東北部或南里奧格蘭德州的大部分地區土壤通常不是紅色的。
註：巴拉圭的部分地區以及鄰近的阿根廷米遜內斯省也有深紅色的土壤，世界上還有少數其他地區也是如此。

text: The most common poles in Brazil have some resemblance to a **ladder **in the bottom portion. They are rectangular, have long segments running through the bottom, and small holes near the top.
NOTE: Paraguay uses similar poles.
text_zh: 巴西最常見的電線桿底部有點像**梯子**。它們呈矩形，底部有長條形切割，靠近頂部有小孔。
註：巴拉圭也使用類似的電線桿。

text: Most Brazilian road signs have the backs painted **black**.
NOTE: This is also common in Paraguay.
text_zh: 大多數巴西道路標誌的背面都被漆成**黑色**。
註：這在巴拉圭也很常見。

text: **Blue road markers** with the road number and kilometre can be seen on the sides of roads.
text_zh: 路邊可以看到寫有道路編號與公里數的**藍色道路標示**。

text: Brazil uses **yellow **on **black **chevrons, as opposed to most of South America, which use black on yellow chevrons.
text_zh: 巴西使用的是**黃色**圖樣位於**黑色**底色上的轉彎標誌，與南美洲大多數使用黃底黑字轉彎標誌的國家不同。

text: Roads in Brazil will usually feature **double yellow** middle lines, with white outer lines. Roads can occasionally have a [single dashed yellow line](https://goo.gl/maps/c8XDntyn1zgp9gah9).
text_zh: 巴西的道路通常帶有**雙黃**中央線與白色外側線。道路偶爾會有[單黃虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/c8XDntyn1zgp9gah9)。

text: There are frequently **white painted kerbs** on Brazilian roads.
text_zh: 巴西道路上經常有**漆成白色的路緣石**。

text: Many houses throughout Brazil have **orange tiled roofs**.
text_zh: 巴西各地的許多房屋都有**橘色瓦片屋頂**。

text: It is fairly common to see **transparent satellite dishes**, which within Latin America is generally unique to Brazil.
text_zh: 看到**透明的小耳朵衛星天線**相當常見，這在拉丁美洲通常是巴西獨有的特徵。

text: **Blue Fortlev water tanks **are often seen on Brazilian roofs.
text_zh: 巴西的屋頂上經常可以看到**藍色的 Fortlev 水塔**。

text: In Generation 3 coverage, you can see two different cars:
- A white car with a [**stubby antenna**](https://goo.gl/maps/NhuDAxCVQ9TjhSUF7). There is a diagonal coil wrapped around the antenna.
- A white car with [**no antenna**](https://goo.gl/maps/nKHjWrdrmbWcUULn6).
The car’s colour is not always visible, meaning you will often see either just the stubby antenna, or no hints of the car at all.
The stubby antenna with a diagonal coil can also be found in Ecuador, Colombia, and Mexico.
text_zh: 在第 3 世代街景覆蓋中，你可以看到兩種不同的車：
- 一輛帶有[**短天線**](https://goo.gl/maps/NhuDAxCVQ9TjhSUF7)的白車。天線周圍纏繞著斜向線圈。
- 一輛[**沒有天線**](https://goo.gl/maps/nKHjWrdrmbWcUULn6)的白車。
車身顏色並不總是可見，這意味著你經常只會看到短天線，或者完全看不到車子的任何線索。
帶有斜向線圈的短天線也可以在厄瓜多、哥倫比亞和墨西哥找到。

text: The Generation 4 cars you can find in Brazil have a visible front, and have one of the following three colour patterns:
- [**Blue**](https://goo.gl/maps/cX9hiLoFAWmSxYLp8)
- [**White with a blue stripe**](https://goo.gl/maps/8m72fEE5hMYAQKF27)
- [**White**](https://goo.gl/maps/fkcFJmPtRwACz2Jv7)
text_zh: 你在巴西能找到的第 4 世代車款可以看到前方車頭，且具有以下三種顏色圖樣之一：
- [**藍色**](https://goo.gl/maps/cX9hiLoFAWmSxYLp8)
- [**帶有藍色條紋的白色**](https://goo.gl/maps/8m72fEE5hMYAQKF27)
- [**白色**](https://goo.gl/maps/fkcFJmPtRwACz2Jv7)

text: Brazil also has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front.
NOTE: Brazil, Peru and Argentina are the only South American countries with smallcam.
text_zh: 巴西也有第 4 世代「小相機（smallcam）」街景覆蓋，它的架設高度比一般第 4 世代低，且具有相對較大的圓形模糊，前方有一點小突出物。
註：巴西、秘魯和阿根廷是南美洲唯一擁有小相機（smallcam）的國家。

text: Most of the coverage in Brazil is along the **eastern **half, with only sparse coverage in the Amazon.

It is useful for beginning players to start forming a rough mental map of where the (limited) coverage is in the western half. When you get Amazonian rounds, this can prevent you from wildly plonking hundreds of kilometres away from the nearest road.
text_zh: 巴西的大多數街景覆蓋集中在**東半部**，亞馬遜地區只有稀疏的街景覆蓋。
對於新手玩家來說，開始在腦海中建立西半部（有限）街景覆蓋大略分布地圖會很有幫助。當你遇到亞馬遜地區的回合時，這可以防止你盲目下針在離最近道路幾百公里遠的地方。

text: **Area codes** are common to see in Brazil. They are often notated using parentheses, or at minimum as two separate numbers. Phone numbers are sometimes without area codes, and without them will be 8 numbers long for landline and 9 for mobile.

The pattern for each of the states is very learnable and useful. The area codes are grouped by first digit, so even just learning those can already help a lot. Notably, area codes ending in 1 will always be around major cities and state capitals.
text_zh: **電話區碼**在巴西很常見。它們通常使用括號標註，或者至少記為兩個獨立的數字。電話號碼有時不帶區碼，沒有區碼時市話為 8 位數字，手機為 9 位數字。
每個州的區碼規律非常容易學習且實用。區碼按第一個數字分組，因此光是掌握首位數字就能提供很大的幫助。值得注意的是，以 1 結尾的區碼總是位於主要城市和州首府附近。

text: Each Brazilian state has a **two-letter acronym**. These show up most prominently in the numbers of state roads (found on kilometre markers). They can also be found in other contexts however.

The state acronyms show up when you zoom out a little bit on Google maps, which is also possible in the minimap while in-game. However, for quick and or competitive games, it can be very useful to learn them by heart anyway, as this can help a lot with eliminating scanning time.
text_zh: 巴西的每個州都有一個**兩個字母的縮寫**。這些最常出現在州道編號（位於公里標誌上）中。然而，它們也可以在其他語境中看到。
在 Google 地圖稍微縮小一點時可以看到各州的縮寫，在遊戲內的縮小地圖中也可以看到。然而，對於快速或競技比賽來說，把它們記熟依然非常有用，因為這能大幅減少在地圖上搜尋的時間。

text: **Postcodes (CEP) **are seen frequently on [street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/7RAf4dB5LnHm3PT36) in Brazil (though sometimes hard to read). The first two numbers will depict an area, a state or multiple states. The numbers go anti-clockwise from São Paulo, ending in Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 巴西的[路牌](https://goo.gl/maps/7RAf4dB5LnHm3PT36)上經常可以看到**郵遞區號（CEP）**（雖然有時很難看清）。前兩位數字代表一個區域、一個州或多個州。數字從聖保羅開始呈逆時針方向排列，最後止於南里奧格蘭德州。

text: Shown here is an **elevation map** of Brazil. It can help to have a rough mental map of where you can find mountains, and which regions are more flat. The highest mountains are generally found near the southeastern coast.
text_zh: 這裡展示的是巴西的**海拔地圖**。在腦海中對哪裡有山脈、哪些地區較平坦有個大概的概念會很有幫助。最高的山脈通常位於東南海岸附近。

text: Northeastern Brazil can be identified by its **dry soil, shrubs and succulents** (the [Caatinga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caatinga) landscape). In rainy season coverage, the shrubs are still recognisable, but can be deceptively green.
text_zh: 巴西東北部的特徵是**乾燥的土壤、灌木和多肉植物**（[卡廷加](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caatinga)地貌）。在雨季的街景中，灌木仍然清晰可辨，但可能會呈現出具有欺騙性的翠綠色。

text: The **Amazon** is a dense rainforest that comprises 40% of Brazil’s total area. Not many roads are within it, but those that are, mostly go through either biodiverse forest or grassy hills with sparse trees.
text_zh: **亞馬遜**是一片茂密的雨林，占巴西總面積的 40%。裡面的道路不多，但有的話，大多穿過生物多樣性豐富的森林，或是樹木稀疏的草丘。

text: Acre has a unique landscape of **small grass hills** and sparsely growing trees. The roads often do not cut around the hills like in most of Brazil, but ride the hills instead. A similar landscape can also be seen near Maraba in the state of Pará.
text_zh: 阿克里州（Acre）擁有獨特的**小草丘**與稀疏樹木景觀。這裡的道路通常不會像巴西大部分地區那樣繞過山丘，而是直接順著山丘起伏。在帕拉州（Pará）的馬拉巴（Maraba）附近也可以看到類似的景觀。

text: Rural locations in Roraima are mostly open **grassy plains with large, distant mountains** in the background. Occasionally, you are on roads within the mountains. Furthermore, the grass in Roraima is distinctly thin, and grows in bunches.
text_zh: 羅賴馬州（Roraima）的鄉村地區大多是開闊的**草坪平原，遠處背景有雄偉山脈**。偶爾你會處於山中的道路上。此外，羅賴馬州的草明顯較細，且成簇生長。

text: The landscape in Rio Grande do Sul can be hilly or flat with lush, green fields. Southern areas can have some resemblance to Uruguay.
text_zh: 南里奧格蘭德州（Rio Grande do Sul）的景觀可以是丘陵或帶有茂盛綠色田野的平地。南部地區與烏拉圭有些相似。

text: Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo often have **rolling grassy hills**.
text_zh: 米納斯吉拉斯州（Minas Gerais）、里約熱內盧州（Rio de Janeiro）和聖埃斯皮里圖州（Espírito Santo）通常擁有**起伏的草丘**。

text: Espírito Santo, and the surrounding areas, often have large mountains with **exposed rock**.
text_zh: 聖埃斯皮里圖州（Espírito Santo）及其周邊地區經常有帶有**裸露岩石**的大山。

text: These distinct trees, called **Paraná pines**, have long horizontal branches with leaves only at the end. They grow mainly in the southern Brazilian states of Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 這些獨特的樹木被稱為**巴拉那松**，擁有長長的水平樹枝，葉子僅長在末端。它們主要生長在巴西南部的巴拉那州（Pará）、聖卡塔琳娜州（Santa Catarina）和南里奧格蘭德州（Rio Grande do Sul）。

text: Coconut palm trees have long leaves, **can grow very tall, and have thin trunks**. They are common across the north eastern states and sometimes further west or south along the coast.
NOTE: Coconut palms grow across the world and are not unique to Brazil.
text_zh: 椰子樹有長葉，**可以長得很高，且樹幹較細**。它們在東北部各州很常見，有時在沿海更偏西或偏南的地方也能看到。
註：椰子樹生長於世界各地，並非巴西特有。

text: Carnaúba palms have short but strong **fan-like leaves**, and a trunk that is smooth at the top and spiked at the bottom. They are commonly seen in Ceará, Piauí, and Rio Grande de Norte, but are also around the town of Xique Xique in Bahia.
text_zh: 巴西蠟掌（Carnaúba）有短而堅韌的**扇形葉片**，樹幹頂部光滑，底部帶刺。它們常見於塞阿拉州（Ceará）、皮奧伊州（Piauí）和北里奧格蘭德州（Rio Grande do Norte），但也出現在巴伊亞州（Bahia）的 Xique Xique 鎮附近。

text: Babassu palms have long, robust leaves comprised of many leaflets. Trunk length can vary from short to tall. They are found throughout the Amazon, or more rarely, down the east coast.
text_zh: 巴巴蘇棕櫚（Babassu）擁有由許多小葉組成的長而強壯的葉子。樹幹高度從矮到高不等。它們遍布於亞馬遜地區，較少見於東海岸一帶。

text: Açai palms produce fruits that are popular globally. Most of these palms are found near Belem, but can be seen across the Amazon. They are distinct in the way the **leaflets droop downward** along with their unusually thin trunks.

NOTE: Most açai palms are found in the Amazon. However, some [visually similar açai subspecies](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qiyQrPPTzgZqcnz88) can rarely occur along the east coast from Santa Catarina all the way to Bahia.
text_zh: 巴西莓樹（Açai）結出全球盛行的果實。這些棕櫚樹大多位於貝倫（Belém）附近，但在整個亞馬遜地區都能看到。它們的特徵是**小葉向下垂掛**，以及異常細長的樹幹。
註：大多數巴西莓樹位於亞馬遜地區。然而，從聖卡塔琳娜州一路到巴伊亞州的東海岸，極少數情況下也會出現一些[外觀相似的巴西莓亞種](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qiyQrPPTzgZqcnz88)。

text: Moriche palms have leaves with a **rounded fan shape**, and often the bottom leaves can be seen **dead and drooping down**. They are most common in Roraima, Amazonas, Tocantins, Goias, and the Amazonian states, but random clusters can be found quite far away from this region.
NOTE: These palms can additionally be found very commonly in the [Amazonian parts of Colombia and Peru](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/71/Distribution_of_Mauritia_flexuosa.png).
text_zh: 模里西棕櫚（Moriche）的葉子呈**圓形扇狀**，通常可以看到底部的葉子**枯死下垂**。它們最常見於羅賴馬州、亞馬遜州、托坎廷斯州、戈亞斯州和亞馬遜地區各州，但在距離這些區域相當遠的地方也能找到零星的集群。
註：這些棕櫚樹在[哥倫比亞與秘魯的亞馬遜區域](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/71/Distribution_of_Mauritia_flexuosa.png)也極為常見。

text: Macaw palms have **thin leaves** compared to other palms, and often have a visible** spear** **shaped** top. They are very common around Mato Grosso do Sul, northern Tocantins, and around Belo Horizonte, but can be seen much further out sometimes. These palms should be used with caution, and single trees are much less of an indicator than multiple trees.
NOTE: [Queen palms](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FqKSDoQwW74P3ES89) can look similar sometimes, but there are less leaves and it looks less dense.
text_zh: 與其他棕櫚樹相比，大花果棕（Macaw palms）擁有**細長的葉子**，且頂部常有明顯的**矛****狀**結構。它們在南馬托格羅索州、托坎廷斯州北部和貝洛奧里藏特（Belo Horizonte）周圍非常常見，但有時在更遠的地方也能看到。使用這種棕櫚樹做判斷時要謹慎，單棵樹的參考價值遠低於多棵樹。
註：[皇后葵](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FqKSDoQwW74P3ES89)有時看起來很像，但葉子較少且看起來沒那麼茂密。

text: This species of plant, with **long stems** and many leaves growing up, are very common in Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, and Paraíba. In the dry season, you can still make out the distinct long stems without leaves.
text_zh: 這種具有**長莖**且許多葉子向上生長的植物品種，在塞阿拉州、北里奧格蘭德州和帕拉伊巴州（Paraíba）非常常見。在旱季時，即使沒有葉子，你依然能辨認出其獨特的長莖。

text: **Very tall grass** can be often seen in the centre of the country, most notably in the Tocantins, Goiás, Bahia, and Minas Gerais states.
text_zh: 在該國中部經常可以看到**非常高聳的草**，尤以托坎廷斯州、戈亞斯州、巴伊亞州和米納斯吉拉斯州最為顯著。

text: **Eucalyptus Grandis**, when fully grown, is a very tall tree with plantations all over Brazil. You can find them in both large and very small plantations., as well as randomly growing anywhere. You can see them all over the south, but there are some large plantations in Amapá too.
text_zh: **巨桉（Eucalyptus Grandis）**完全長成後是非常高大的樹木，巴西各地都有種植園。無論是在大型或微型種植園，還是在任何地方隨機生長，都能找到它們。你在整個南部都能看到它們，但阿馬帕州（Amapá）也有一些大型種植園。

text: **Sugarcane plantations** are by far most common in the state of São Paulo, and are common in Paraná, Mato Grosso do Sul, and in the coastal north eastern states.
text_zh: **甘蔗種植園**在聖保羅州最為常見，在巴拉那州、南馬托格羅索州以及東北部沿海各州也很普遍。

text: **Soybeans** appear as small, leafy soil grown plants. They are most commonly grown in Mato Grosso, Paraná, and Goiás.
text_zh: **黃豆**呈現為矮小、多葉的土生植物。它們最常種植於馬托格羅索州、巴拉那州和戈亞斯州。

text: **Coffee beans** are by far the most common in Minas Gerais, but also can be found in Espírito Santo and northeastern São Paulo.
text_zh: **咖啡豆**在米納斯吉拉斯州最為常見，但在聖埃斯皮里圖州和聖保羅州東北部也能找到。

text: Alongside ladder poles, **round poles** can often be found across the south of Brazil, especially São Paulo. These poles are cylindrical and made of concrete.

NOTE: This map and the following wooden pole map was created using statistical analysis of semi-urban and rural locations. 434 locations of 3 poles per location were used across 16 states that were thought to have mixed poles. Regardless of the state, the centre of large cities will often have round poles.
text_zh: 除了梯形桿外，在巴西南部（尤其是聖保羅州）經常可以看到**圓形電線桿**。這些電線桿為圓柱形且由混凝土製成。
註：這張地圖以及接下來的木製電線桿地圖是透過對半城鎮與鄉村地點進行統計分析製作而成的。研究使用了 16 個被認為混用不同電線桿的州、共 434 個地點（每個地點取 3 根電線桿）。無論在哪個州，大城市的中心通常都會有圓形電線桿。

text: Some states also use **wooden poles**. They are most commonly seen in Rio Grande do Sul, Roraima, Amazonas, and Rio de Janeiro.
text_zh: 一些州也會使用**木製電線桿**。它們最常見於南里奧格蘭德州、羅賴馬州、亞馬遜州和里約熱內盧州。

text: Brazil often uses **supports **on its electricity poles that connect the crossbar to the stem of the pole. The frequency of pole supports varies greatly state-to-state. It is notably rare in the northeast.
NOTE: This tip only works for poles that have a crossbar.
text_zh: 巴西的電線桿經常使用**支撐桿 **將橫樑連接到桿身。電線桿支撐桿的出現頻率因州而異，在東北部尤其罕見。
註：此技巧僅適用於帶有橫樑的電線桿。

text: Poles with a **single support **are most commonly found in the states of Tocantins, Santa Catarina, and Minas Gerais.
text_zh: 帶有**單支撐桿 **的電線桿最常見於托坎廷斯州、聖卡塔琳娜州和米納斯吉拉斯州。

text: Markings on poles are used by the electricity companies to identify them. This pole ID is **long**, **yellow** **pole paint **with a black code. The ones that start with a letter are found in Bahia and Pernambuco.
text_zh: 電力公司會在電線桿上記號以供識別。這種電線桿編號是帶有黑色代碼的**長條**、**黃色** **電線桿塗漆 **。開頭為字母的編號可在巴伊亞州和伯南布哥州（Pernambuco）找到。

text: Similar to the Bahia and Pernambuco poles, Goiás poles also use **long, yellow pole paint **with a black paint code, but it always starts with a number. They also have a rarer yellow on black pole ID, which can be either paint or a plate.
text_zh: 與巴伊亞州和伯南布哥州的電線桿類似，戈亞斯州的電線桿也使用帶有黑色代碼的**長條黃色電線桿塗漆 **，但它總是以數字開頭。它們還有一種較罕見的黃底黑字電線桿編號，可以是塗漆或牌子。

text: This **small yellow or orange plate** attached onto the pole by thin metal or zip tie is found in Rio Grande do Norte and Pernambuco. This ID is usually much higher up the pole in Pernambuco than in Rio Grande do Norte.
text_zh: 這種用細金屬線或束帶固定在電線桿上的**小黃色或橘色牌子**出現在北里奧格蘭德州和伯南布哥州。這個編號在伯南布哥州的電線桿上通常位置高得多。

text: Pole IDs in Paraná are usually made up of **black paint** and yellow or white painted text.
text_zh: 巴拉那州的電線桿編號通常由**黑色塗漆**以及黃色或白色刷漆文字組成。

text: Most poles in Maranhão have a **small beige plate with numbers** built into the surface of the pole. This pole ID can be found in Pará and Piauí more rarely.
text_zh: 馬拉尼昂州（Maranhão）的大多數電線桿都有**嵌入電線桿表面的帶數字小米色牌**。這種電線桿編號在帕拉州和皮奧伊州較少見。

text: Utility poles in Paraná on intersections are sometimes **painted with the street name**. This can sometimes extend to Santa Catarina or Rio Grande do Sul if there are ladder poles in the city.
text_zh: 巴拉那州十字路口處的電線桿有時會**刷上路名**。如果城市裡有梯形電線桿，這種情況有時也會延伸到聖卡塔琳娜州或南里奧格蘭德州。

text: This poletop, consisting of an **asymmetrical crossbar** and a **support** reaching to the middle of the longer** **part of the crossbar, is the most common poletop in the state of São Paulo. It can also be frequently seen in the states of Rio Grande do Sul, Rio de Janeiro and Mato Grosso do Sul.
text_zh: 這種桿頂結構由**不對稱橫樑**以及連接至橫樑較長** **部分的**支撐桿**組成，是聖保羅州最常見的桿頂結構。在南里奧格蘭德州、里約熱內盧州和南馬托格羅索州也經常可以看到。

text: This **asymmetrical** **crossbar** with **no supports** is exclusive to Ceara and Rondonia.
NOTE: While the crossbar in Ceara is usually made of concrete, the [Rondonian variation](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nXUtLu6sWXvN4zfF8) features a metal crossbar, and is far less common.
text_zh: 這種**不對稱** **橫樑**且**無支撐桿**的結構是塞阿拉州和朗多尼亞州（Rondônia）特有的。
註：雖然塞阿拉州的橫樑通常由混凝土製成，但[朗多尼亞州的變體](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nXUtLu6sWXvN4zfF8)採用金屬橫樑，且極不常見。

text: This pole configuration, featuring a zigzag-shaped top bar resting atop a flat crossbar, is exclusive to Ceara and Roraima. The pole is usually much larger than a regular electricity pole.
text_zh: 這種電線桿配置在扁平橫樑上方設有鋸齒狀頂桿，是塞阿拉州和羅賴馬州特有的。這種電線桿通常比普通電線桿大得多。

text: Poles that have a smooth cone on top, often called a **pencil pole**,** **are common in the state of Rio de Janeiro and rarely in Brasília and Manaus.
text_zh: 頂部有平滑圓錐體的電線桿（常被稱為**鉛筆桿**）** **在里約熱內盧州很常見，在巴西利亞和瑪瑙斯（Manaus）則很罕見。

text: **Gamma-shaped ("Γ")** poles containing **electricity boxes** at the end of the bar are most commonly seen in the state of Rio de Janeiro and in the cities of Belém, Salvador, Fortaleza and Maceió.
NOTE: A variation with a [shorter bar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AQ9y7AkQfqjh7KjV9) is exclusive to Belém.
text_zh: 橫樑末端帶有**電箱**的**伽瑪形（"Γ"）**電線桿最常見於里約熱內盧州，以及貝倫、薩爾瓦多、福塔雷薩（Fortaleza）和馬塞約（Maceió）等城市。
註：帶有[較短橫樑](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AQ9y7AkQfqjh7KjV9)的變體是貝倫特有的。

text: You may frequently see** electricity counters** attached to the poles in Cuiabá, Macapá and large cities in the state of Pará.
NOTE: The electricity counter may consist of one or [several ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cHRjDx6cB5YRJZHi7)compartments.
text_zh: 你可能會經常在庫亞巴（Cuiabá）、馬卡帕（Macapá）和帕拉州的大城市看到附掛在電線桿上的** 電表**。
註：電表可能由一個或[多個 ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cHRjDx6cB5YRJZHi7)分室組成。

text: Poles that have one insulator on top and **alternating** horizontal insulators can be found in Mato Grosso and southern Acre. It is also very rare in Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 頂部有一個絕緣子且帶有**交錯**水平絕緣子的電線桿可以在馬托格羅索州和阿克里州南部找到。這在南里奧格蘭德州也極為罕見。

text: Insulators that resemble **brown mushrooms** are only found in Pernambuco.
text_zh: 外形酷似**棕色蘑菇**的絕緣子僅存在於伯南布哥州。

text: Insulators that resemble **white mushrooms** are found in Bahia and rarely Brasília.
text_zh: 外形酷似**白色蘑菇**的絕緣子出現在巴伊亞州，極少見於巴西利亞。

text: **Transparent** insulators are mostly in Alagoas in the northeast, and Santa Catarina in the south. They can be seen rarely in Sergipe, Ceará, and Brasília.
text_zh: **透明**絕緣子主要分佈在東北部的阿拉戈斯州（Alagoas）和南部的聖卡塔琳娜州。在塞爾希培州（Sergipe）、塞阿拉州和巴西利亞偶爾也能看到。

text: These insulators have a shape resembling a **spool of thread**. They are found mostly in Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo, and have been seen in Ceará.
text_zh: 這些絕緣子的形狀類似**線軸**。它們主要存在於里約熱內盧州和聖埃斯皮里圖州，也在塞阿拉州出現過。

text: Insulators in Ceará can sometimes be uniquely **long and thin**. They are in Goiás too, but are rare.
text_zh: 塞阿拉州的絕緣子有時會呈現獨特的**細長**形狀。它們在戈亞斯州也有，但很罕見。

text: Poles with **horizontal insulators** are very common in Pará and less so in Mato Grosso. They are rarely found in Acre, Amapá, Tocantins, Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 帶有**水平絕緣子**的電線桿在帕拉州非常常見，在馬托格羅索州則少一些。它們在阿克里州、阿馬帕州、托坎廷斯州、聖卡塔琳娜州和南里奧格蘭德州很少見。

text: **Long grey insulators**, not including when they are horizontal, are most commonly found in Pará, Mato Grosso, Tocantins, Bahia, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná and Santa Catarina.
They are found rarely in Maranhão, Rio Grande do Norte, Alagoas, Sergipe, Rondônia, and Rio Grande do Sul. Other states have between 0 and 5%.
text_zh: **灰色長絕緣子**（不包括水平安裝的情況）最常見於帕拉州、馬托格羅索州、托坎廷斯州、巴伊亞州、南馬托格羅索州、巴拉那州和聖卡塔琳娜州。
它們在馬拉尼昂州、北里奧格蘭德州、阿拉戈斯州、塞爾希培州、朗多尼亞州和南里奧格蘭德州很少見。其他州的出現率在 0% 到 5% 之間。

text: Poles with these **black double UFO-shaped insulators in a trident formation** are common in Maranhão. The insulator itself is common across many states, but not in this configuration.
text_zh: 帶有這種**三叉戟排列的黑色雙飛碟形絕緣子**的電線桿在馬拉尼昂州很常見。這種絕緣子本身在許多州都很常見，但不會是這種排列方式。

text: These insulators are spherical or cone shaped and suspended on a rod above the insulator bar. They are often referred to as **“lollipop” insulators**. They are very common in Rio Grande de Norte, Paraíba, Pernambuco, and more rarely, Sergipe.
text_zh: 這些絕緣子呈球形或錐形，懸掛在絕緣子桿上方的金屬棒上。它們通常被稱為**「棒棒糖」絕緣子**。它們在北里奧格蘭德州、帕拉伊巴州、伯南布哥州非常常見，在塞爾希培州較罕見。

text: These **dark brown insulators** with grey bases are found almost exclusively in Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: 這些帶有灰色底座的**深棕色絕緣子**幾乎僅見於聖卡塔琳娜州和南里奧格蘭德州。

text: Brazil often uses metal trash baskets outside houses. In Acre and Rondônia, however, it is much more common to see them made of **concrete**.
text_zh: 巴西人經常在房屋外設置金屬垃圾籃。然而在阿克里州和朗多尼亞州，更常見的是用**混凝土**製作的垃圾籃。

text: Lamps in Minas Gerais and Goias will often feature **two parts** to them. They can also be found in** **Rio Grande do Norte, Ceará, Rio Grande do Sul as well as the Federal District.
text_zh: 米納斯吉拉斯州和戈亞斯州的路燈通常包含**兩個部分**。它們也可以在** **北里奧格蘭德州、塞阿拉州、南里奧格蘭德州以及聯邦區找到。

text: Lamps in urban northern Paraná sometimes have **no lamp arm**. Styles contrast, and are either colourful, plastic and industrial, or look fancy and ornate. Both versions are most commonly found in northwest Paraná.
text_zh: 巴拉那州北部城鎮的路燈有時**沒有燈臂**。風格對比鮮明，要麼是色彩鮮豔的塑膠工業風，要麼看起來華麗典雅。這兩種版本最常見於巴拉那州西北部。

text: The vast majority of poles in Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Pará, Amapá, Rio Grande do Norte, Pernambuco and Santa Catarina have the **lamp arm attached** to the pole, as opposed to it being attached with a plate, which is much more common generally.
text_zh: 馬托格羅索州、南馬托格羅索州、帕拉州、阿馬帕州、北里奧格蘭德州、伯南布哥州和聖卡塔琳娜州的大多數電線桿都是**燈臂直接固定**在桿身，而非一般較常見的透過固定板連接。

text: Lamps in Roraima have a **similar style** but have **different colours** in the main cities. Boa Vista, Normandia, and Mucajaí have red lamps, Rorainópolis has blue lamps, Pacaraima and Iracema have green, and Caracaraí has yellow.
text_zh: 羅賴馬州的路燈具有**相似風格**，但在主要城市中採用**不同顏色**。博阿維斯塔（Boa Vista）、諾曼地亞（Normandia）和穆卡熱伊（Mucajaí）為紅燈，羅賴諾波利斯（Rorainópolis）為藍燈，帕卡賴馬（Pacaraima）和伊拉塞馬（Iracema）為綠燈，卡拉卡拉伊（Caracaraí）為黃燈。

text: Lamps in Ceará often have a **fancy and colourful arm**, whether as lampposts or attached to utility poles. It sometimes says the town on the arm.
text_zh: 塞阿拉州的路燈無論是獨立路燈桿還是附掛在電線桿上，通常都帶有**華麗且色彩鮮豔的燈臂**。燈臂上有時會印有城鎮名稱。

text: São Paulo has far more **divided highways** than any other state.
text_zh: 聖保羅州擁有的**分隔公路**遠多於其他任何州。

text: **Phone numbers** can sometimes be seen underneath kilometre markers in São Paulo.
text_zh: 在聖保羅州，里程碑下方有時可以看到**電話號碼**。

text: **Cobblestone pavement** is most common in the northeast and in Rio Grande do Sul.
text_zh: **石塊路面**在東北部和南里奧格蘭德州最常見。

text: Roads with **hexagonal** concrete tiles can be found across Brazil, but they are more common in Santa Catarina and Minas Gerais.
text_zh: 鋪有**六角形**混凝土磚的路面在巴西各地都能找到，但在聖卡塔琳娜州和米納斯吉拉斯州更為常見。

text: Some roads in Acre are made of **red brick**.
text_zh: 阿克里州的部分道路是由**紅磚**鋪成的。

text: Cobblestone roads with **randomly sized stones** are most common in southeast Rio Grande do Sul and Minas Gerais.
text_zh: 由**大小不一石塊**鋪成的鵝卵石路在南里奧格蘭德州東南部和米納斯吉拉斯州最常見。

text: These **uneven** but mostly **square** stone roads are seen in western Rio Grande do Sul and west Santa Catarina. The soil will often be very dark in these regions too.
NOTE: The same roads are seen in the Misiones province of Argentina.
text_zh: 這些**高低不平**但大多呈**方形**的石路可見於南里奧格蘭德州西部和聖卡塔琳娜州西部。這些地區的土壤通常也非常深色。
註：阿根廷米西奧內斯省（Misiones）也有相同的道路。

text: You can often see pavements in Rio Grande do Sul that have **brown tiles** but are either jagged and random, or square. This style can sometimes be seen in Santa Catarina.
text_zh: 你經常可以在南里奧格蘭德州看到帶有**棕色地磚**的人行道，這些地磚要麼參差不齊且隨機排列，要麼呈方形。這種風格有時在聖卡塔琳娜州也能看到。

text: Buildings in the southern states, mainly Santa Catarina, can be of **European influence** (typically vaguely German) in design and style.
text_zh: 南部各州（主要是聖卡塔琳娜州）的建築在設計與風格上可能受到**歐洲風格影響**（通常隱約帶有德國風格）。

text: Wooden houses on stilts are very common in the state of Acre.
NOTE: They are also seen more rarely in low-lying Amazonas and Pará, as well as various other countries.
text_zh: 高腳木屋在阿克里州非常常見。
註：在地勢低窪的亞馬遜州和帕拉州，以及其他一些國家，這種建築也較為少見地出現。

text: Many roads in Piauí have **red gravel **on the side of the road. The gravel can appear spread [above the tarmac shoulder](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A3k1mmWsApnmRQpU9) or on roads with curbs.
NOTE: This can appear elsewhere. Use with caution.
text_zh: 皮奧伊州的許多道路旁都有**紅砂礫**。砂礫可能鋪在[瀝青路肩上](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A3k1mmWsApnmRQpU9)或出現在有路緣石的道路上。
注意：這也可能出現在其他地方，請謹慎使用。

text: In all Generation 4 coverage in Amapá, the front right of the camera is **smudged**. In addition, all Generation 4 coverage in Amapá features the white car with the blue stripe.
text_zh: 在阿馬帕州所有的 4 代街景覆蓋中，相機右前方都**有污漬**。此外，阿馬帕州所有的 4 代街景覆蓋都帶有藍色條紋的白車。

text: These spheres on top of utility poles are **João-de-Barro nests**. They are common across the south of Brazil.
text_zh: 電線桿頂部的這些球體是**棕灶鳥的巢**。它們在巴西南部很常見。

text: The landscape near the town of Uiramuta, in northern Roraima, features a very distinct landscape. It is dry, with large mountains containing numerous “folds.”
text_zh: 羅賴馬州北部威拉穆特鎮附近的景觀非常獨特。那裡氣候乾燥，有著許多具有「摺皺」的大山。

text: Coastal regions in Rio Grande do Sul are recognisable due to being a rare **flat wetland**, which is uncommon in Brazil.
text_zh: 南里奧格蘭德州的沿海地區很好辨認，因為它是巴西罕見的**平坦濕地**。

text: The 364 through Acre is very recognisable due to the **rollercoaster-like landscape and road**: the road uniquely rides the hills rather than snaking around them. There is usually no traffic, and is covered mostly by Generation 4 blue car.
text_zh: 穿過阿克里州的 364 號公路非常容易辨認，因為它有**雲霄飛車般的景觀和道路**：這條道路獨特地直接跨越丘陵，而不是繞著丘陵蜿蜒而行。通常沒有車流，且大部分是由 4 代藍車拍攝。

text: The Amazonas 319 has a very lush, bright green and tropical landscape, as it **cuts through the Amazon rainforest**. The road is flat and mostly unpaved, featuring bright orange soil. However, closer to Manaus the road becomes paved. There are wooden or ladder poles alongside the entire stretch. It is covered by the blue Generation 4 car.
text_zh: 亞馬遜州的 319 號公路擁有非常茂密、鮮綠且具熱帶風情的景觀，因為它**穿越亞馬遜雨林**。這條道路平坦且大部分未鋪設柏油，帶有鮮橘色的土壤。不過，靠近瑪瑙斯時道路會變成鋪設好的柏油路。整段路旁邊都有木桿或梯形桿。這條路是由藍色 4 代車拍攝的。

text: The Pará section of the 163 is often **hilly, curvy, dry, and sometimes hazy**. It has a wide range of amazonian vegetation. The road is frequently trafficked, usually by transportation trucks. It is covered by the blue Generation 4 car in the north and the Smallcam car in the south.
text_zh: 163 號公路帕拉州路段通常**多丘陵、多彎道、乾燥且有時霧濛濛**。它有著豐富的亞馬遜植被。這條道路車流量大，通常是運輸卡車。北方由藍色 4 代車覆蓋，南方由 Smallcam 車覆蓋。

text: São Paulo has a **square, yellow** pole ID paint. It has three letters on top followed by two numbers, a black line, and four more numbers. The three letters represent the municipality within São Paulo, but are rarely visible.
text_zh: 聖保羅的電線桿上有**方形黃色**的編號噴漆。頂部有三個字母，後面跟著兩個數字、一條黑線和另外四個數字。這三個字母代表聖保羅州內的自治市，但很少能看清。

text: Street signs in [Campo Grande](https://goo.gl/maps/bP6rWChW4MMmzJS18) and [Joinville](https://goo.gl/maps/1UTu9TZ3KLZK4kxv7) are **stickers** wrapped around a pole at intersections. Campo Grande signs usually have extra information and a red and yellow stripe.
text_zh: 在[大坎普](https://goo.gl/maps/bP6rWChW4MMmzJS18)與[若茵維利](https://goo.gl/maps/1UTu9TZ3KLZK4kxv7)，路標是路口處包裹在桿子上的**貼紙**。大坎普的路標通常會有額外資訊以及紅黃相間的條紋。

text: Lamps in Rio de Janeiro are **curved** through the whole of the lamp arm, which is not seen anywhere else.
text_zh: 里約熱內盧的路燈整個燈臂都**呈弧形**，這在其他地方是看不到的。

text: Teresina lamps are usually **blue** with an **orange arm**.
text_zh: 特雷西納的路燈通常是**藍色**的，帶有**橘色燈臂**。

text: Belém lamp heads are often **orange**.
text_zh: 貝倫的路燈頭通常是**橘色**的。

text: Cuiaba lamps are usually a **light green**, and is one of the few cities that has poles with multiple electricity metres, sometimes 6 to 12.
text_zh: 庫亞巴的路燈通常是**淺綠色**，而且是少數電線桿上裝有多個電錶（有時多達 6 到 12 個）的城市之一。

text: Lamps in Belo Horizonte and Uberaba in Generation 4 can have a **white, numbered plaque** attached to the lamp. In Belo Horizonte, the tag starts with 0 or 1, and in Uberaba, it starts with a 1 or 2.
Since this plaque is new, it may appear in other cities in Minas Gerais in the future.
text_zh: 貝洛奧里藏特和烏貝拉巴在 4 代街景中的路燈上可能附有**標有編號的白色銘牌**。在貝洛奧里藏特，標牌以 0 或 1 開頭，而在烏貝拉巴，則以 1 或 2 開頭。
由於這種銘牌是新出現的，未來可能會出現在米納斯吉拉斯州的其他城市。

text: Lamps in Caxias do Sul usually have a **zig-zag** bent pole and a yellow head.
text_zh: 南卡西亞斯的路燈通常有**鋸齒狀**彎曲的燈桿和黃色的燈頭。

text: Poles on Santa Catarina Island (Florianópolis) are painted **white** with **blue and red stripes**.
text_zh: 聖卡塔琳娜島（弗洛里亞諾波利斯）上的桿子被漆成**白色**，並帶有**藍紅相間條紋**。

text: You can often see **rifts** in Alagoas Generation 3 coverage.
text_zh: 你在阿拉戈斯州的 3 代街景覆蓋中經常可以看到**接圖裂縫**。

text: Northwest Rio Grande do Sul has coverage with this **camera glitch** in Generation 3.
text_zh: 南里奧格蘭德州西北部的 3 代街景覆蓋帶有這種**相機故障特徵**。

text: This **Amazonian trekker** combines [boat](https://goo.gl/maps/oUDek9JNat9NFZAt6) and walking coverage on and near the Madeira and Aripuana rivers, south of the 319. They are seen travelling through dense rainforest and small villages.
text_zh: 這項**亞馬遜徒步拍攝**結合了 319 號公路以南的馬代拉河與阿里普阿南河及其附近的[乘船](https://goo.gl/maps/oUDek9JNat9NFZAt6)與步行覆蓋。可以看到拍攝者穿梭於茂密的雨林和小村莊之間。

text: The beautiful National Park of Northeast Maranhão, known for its **sand dunes** with pools of water, has [walking trekker](https://goo.gl/maps/Pftf1x4EiqezRmw38) and [vehicle coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/atT5yDswGMP8jaWs9). The truck is white with a black bed. The landscape can vary from beach to sandy wetland.
text_zh: 馬拉尼昂州東北部美麗的國家公園以帶有水池的**沙丘**聞名，那裡有[徒步拍攝](https://goo.gl/maps/Pftf1x4EiqezRmw38)和[車輛拍攝覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/atT5yDswGMP8jaWs9)。貨車是白色的，帶有黑色車斗。景觀可以從海灘變化到沙質濕地。

text: Ilha de Fernando de Noronha is a **Brazilian island** with official coverage approximately 340 kilometres northeast of Rio Grande do Norte, and the country itself. It is covered by a white buggy, which is visible at the front. The island is similar in vegetation to the closest part of mainland Brazil, and has large exposed rocks. There is also [boat coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/YGr29mutxGNbnuXL7) around the island.
text_zh: 費爾南多·迪諾羅尼亞島是一座位於北里奧格蘭德州暨巴西本土東北方約 340 公里處且有官方覆蓋的**巴西島嶼**。它是由車頭可見的白色沙灘車覆蓋的。該島的植被與最接近的巴西本土部分相似，並有巨大的裸露岩石。島嶼周圍還有[乘船拍攝覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/YGr29mutxGNbnuXL7)。
